The observed interaction implies that Theophylline could modulate the activity of Slc22a7, which is relevant to the pathophysiology of Atrial Tachycardia. The evidence is supported by a direct interaction between Enalapril and Slc22a7, indicating a possible mechanistic link between Theophylline and Slc22a7. The strength of the evidence is moderate, as it is based on a single interaction, and further studies would be needed to confirm the role of Theophylline in this process.
